senses.gloss: जामि tautologous, unnecessarily repeated; the word is defined and illustrated by Yaska as;-तद्यत्समान्या- मृचि समानाभिव्याहारं भवति तज्जामि भवतीत्येकं । मधुमन्तं मधुश्चुतमिति यथा Nir.x.16.2. For other definitions of the word जामि conveying practically the same idea, cf. Nir.X. 16. 3 and 4.
